name: Infrastructure Oversight Board - DARK - Jul 23, 2026
agenda_text:
INFRASTRUCTURE OVERSIGHT BOARD NOTICE OF
  CANCELLATION

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Regular Meeting of the Infrastructure Oversight Board,

scheduled for July 23, 2026 has been cancelled. The next regularly scheduled meeting will take

place on Thursday, August 27, 2026, at 150 N. Third Street, Burbank, CA 91502, Room 104.

Dated: July 20, 2026

  s/ Matthew De Vera
  Matthew De Vera
  Senior Clerk

AFFIDAVIT OF POSTING

I, Matthew De Vera, declare as follows: That I am the duly designated and qualified Senior Clerk for the City of
Burbank Public Works Department and that I cause the above notice to be posted at Burbank City Hall and the
City website on July 20, 2026.

  By: Matthew De Vera, Senior Clerk
